## Pygmy Gnoll (CR 1)

**XP** 400  
CE Small humanoid (gnoll)  
**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +2  


**Defense**


**AC** 18, touch 13, flat-footed 16 (+2 armor, +2 Dex, +1 natural, +2 shield, +1 size)  
**hp** 11 (2d8+2)  
**Fort** +4, **Ref** +2, **Will** +0  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** spear +3 (1d6/×3) or bite +2 (1d3 plus 1 bleed).  
**Ranged** longbow +3 (1d6+2/×3)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 10, **Dex** 14, **Con** 12, **Int** 8, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 8  
**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +0; **CMD** 12  
**Feats** [Weapon Focus (spear)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Deadly Aim](../../rules/feats/deadly-aim.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Deadly Aim needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (spear).*  
**Skills** Perception +2  
**Language** Gnoll  
**Gear** leather armor, heavy wooden shield, longbow, spear  


**Special Abilities**


**Darkvision (60 feet)** A pygmy gnoll can see in the dark (black and white vision only).  

**Deadly Aim -1/+2** A pygmy gnoll can take a penalty to ranged attacks to gain the same bonus to ranged damage.
